findings.control: Cleanup never writes or closes queued stdin and excludes stdin POLLOUT.
New cleanup drain faults reach cleanup_errors while teardown continues.
Reject equal or nested evidence roots within job-writable state before filesystem effects.
Distinguish bounded drain exhaustion and mark EOF-dependent group termination forced before reaping.
Pin all intermediate ancestors and the leaf and reject changed custody.
Recheck state/config path identities before work and start delivery without blocking state-independent cleanup.
Require the exact canonical Git top-level root.
Authenticate physical blob bytes and all consumed bundle inputs against the original pinned tree.
Read the original baseline with replacement objects disabled.
Include the executed supervisor and pinned reference JSON in every source manifest.
Decode only exact numeric -0 as integer zero without altering original bytes or accepting fractional/exponent integer tokens.
Replace validator Git diffs with exact original-tree versus stage-0 index comparison.
Authenticate raw commit and every tree body against the independently pinned object chain before deriving inventory.
Disable lazy fetching and reject missing required objects without invoking promisor helpers.

additionalCorrections: Final-component absence requires the held leaf to be unlinked under a stable ancestor chain.
Select the actual frozen policy-initialize.rs and require its audit inclusion.
Use exact ./ Bun test file selectors and sparse audit fixtures to prevent clone discovery.
